In part (b) some responses tried to use the Lagrange 
Error bound. 

•

the series for f (−3) was alternating, or that the error 
bound was the alternating series error bound. 

• 
Some responses failed to use the fourth term of the 
series as the error bound. 

•

series and tried to find the difference between S

scoring in this case but would in most other situations.
